evals.prompt: Set up our brand kit. Logo is ./brand/northwind-logo.png and there's a white version ./brand/northwind-logo-white.png. Our colours are #0E5A46 and #F2A541. We use Georgia for headings. Website is northwindhealth.example.
assertions: Writes brand.json next to the logo files, with logo.primary and logo.on_dark set to the two supplied paths
colors.primary is #0E5A46 and colors.accent is #F2A541; secondary, background and text are filled and listed as derived
fonts.heading.family is Georgia; the body font is either asked for or marked as a default, not presented as the brand's
Every value has a source, with derived values tagged [inferred]
Runs check_brand.py and reports its contrast figures
Writes a one-page BRAND.md with a colour table (role, hex, use)
Invents no tagline, phone number, address or legal footer
